title: Can Complexity and Uncomputability Explain Intelligence? SuperARC: A Test for Artificial Super Intelligence Based on Recursive Compression

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs on sequence prediction and code generation tasks using algorithmically generated sequences of varying complexity (SuperARC) to distinguish true algorithmic reasoning and abstraction from statistical pattern matching and training data memorization.

Developing an objective, human-agnostic intelligence metric based on Algorithmic Information Theory (AIT) and comparing model performance on this metric against traditional benchmarks to reveal how standard tests artificially inflate perceived intelligence by relying on human-like knowledge and cognitive priors.
